name: queue-position
title: Queue position
description: A waiting-room panel for being in line: your place, an honest wait range, and a Leave button that asks before it lets go of the spot.
docs: position is the place (1 is next); total, joinedAt (written in timeZone), startPosition (the bar fills from there; default the farthest back the panel has seen) and estimateSeconds (written as a range, never a promise) fill in the rest. status 'ready' shows It is your turn with the action (onEnter) and the hold counting down (holdSeconds, or holdEndsAt from your server), then calls onExpire when it runs out. onLeave runs on the second press of Leave the line. The number counts through whole places to each new place, and its suffix steps aside while it counts when a place on the way would need another one (5th to 2nd); Enter now takes the focus back once its promise settles. A screen reader is told the place only every fifth place and for each of the last three, and the hold only at its start, at thirty seconds and at its end.
